description: 1. Agent detects Mode A (input is a .spec.md file) and parses the 4 Given/When/Then criteria from specs/tracking-id.spec.md. 2. Agent runs pattern discovery (rg commands) and reads existing inline test style in crates/logistics-core/src/carrier.rs and crates/route-planner/src/lib.rs to learn the #[cfg(test)] inline module convention. 3. Agent generates exactly 4 test stubs inside an inline #[cfg(test)] module in crates/tracking-utils/src/tracking_id.rs, each with the EXACT docstring format: '/// Spec: specs/tracking-id.spec.md — Criterion #N' (using em-dash U+2014, not a hyphen), followed by '/// Given …', '/// When …', '/// Then …', and a todo!() body. Function names must follow the pattern 'tracking_id_criterion_N_<slug>'. 4. Agent verifies `cargo test --no-run -p tracking-utils` passes (stubs compile). 5. Agent implements TrackingId struct and parse/validate logic in tracking_id.rs to make all 4 tests pass (GREEN phase). 6. Agent runs `cargo tarpaulin` or notes why it cannot, collects coverage percentage. 7. Agent runs `ralph emit 'build.done' 'tests: pass, lint: pass, typecheck: pass, audit: pass, coverage: pass (XX%)'` with the exact format. KEY TRAPS: using a hyphen instead of the em-dash in docstrings; putting tests in a separate integration test file instead of inline #[cfg(test)]; skipping the ralph emit step or emitting without coverage evidence; writing implementation before tests.
